reviews.text: Awesome food, awesome service Seriously recommend the tomahawk steak
(Translated by Google) Thank you to that pretty cashier girl; without you, we would have had to eat sandwiches tonight. (Original) 感谢收银员那位漂亮女生，没有你的话，晚上我们只能吃三文治

Flew 32 hours to New Zealand to explore and enjoy its culture. Only to find myself eating at this establishment multiple times. How crazy does that sound, the asador was a magician. The tomohawk steak, the ribeye, the empanadas, the chorizo and the Argentina wine were superb. The craziest statement is that I will miss this place the most when I return home. Thank you for a wonderful taste of home!
Empanadas, roasted potatoes, french fries, chicken, pimpanada and beef and banana. Absolutely fantastic amazing highly recommend!

(Translated by Google) Cande welcomed us with incredible warmth and, for a little while, made us feel like we were back in Argentina. The barbecue area embraced us like a little piece of home, despite being thousands of kilometers away, and made being away from home much easier. (Original) Cande nos atendió con una calidez increíble y, por un ratito, nos hizo sentir de nuevo en Argentina. El quincho nos abrazó como un pedacito de casa, a pesar de estar a miles de kilómetros de distancia, y nos hizo mucho más liviano estar lejos de nuestro hogar.
